The mechanism — finger caught and pulled while extended — fits perfectly. X-ray was ordered but no results reported yet; however, a lateral view would be critical to rule out an avulsion fracture at the dorsal base of the distal phalanx (which would classify it as a *bony mallet* vs. *tendinous mallet*).
